hypotheses.storyTitle: Advancing Financial Mastery for Home Ownership

hypotheses.customerSituation: Sophie has achieved 63 percent progress on her First Home Savings Knowledge goal and maintains 3900 LBG coins.
hypotheses.storyTension: Maintaining steady educational momentum without artificial deadlines or competitive public rankings.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Engaging seamlessly with goal-linked educational modules, tracking progress clearly, and reinforcing financial literacy milestones.
